prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE realistic, exceptionally polished desktop web-app screen, 1536x1024 landscape, edge to edge, no device or browser chrome. STYLE: match the attached reference screenshots exactly; they are the real product (Birdcar Admin). Same Flux UI Pro components, same Inter typeface at the same sizes and weights, same white content surface, same very light gray (zinc-50) left sidebar with a hairline right border, same 'B' logo tile plus 'Admin' at top-left with the sidebar-collapse icon, same zinc-800 ink and zinc-500 secondary text, same thin zinc-200 dividers, same 8px-rounded inputs with a faint shadow, same deep teal #214b57 used ONLY for the current-item indicator, primary buttons and small checkmarks, same pale-teal 'Saved' badge style, same small outline icons. Light mode. No gradients, no illustrations, no drop-shadowed cards, no colored panels, no decorative imagery, no emoji, no small tracked uppercase labels. Spell every quoted word exactly as written. SIDEBAR (256px wide, identical to the reference): top 'B' logo tile + 'Admin' + collapse icon. Nav items: 'Home' (house icon), 'Publishing' (document icon). There is NO 'Mail' item in the sidebar. Flexible spacer. Near the bottom, directly above the account button, a 'Settings' item with a gear icon, shown as the CURRENT item with the same light gray-teal highlight pill and thin teal left indicator the reference uses for its current item. Very bottom: the account button with an 'N' initials square, 'nick.cannariato@...' and a chevron. HEADER: a 56px content header bar with a hairline bottom border and the word 'Settings' in small medium-weight text at its left. CONTENT (the structure is the point): a left-aligned column about 1040px wide, same left margin as the reference. 1. Page title 'Settings' and one muted line: 'How Admin is set up right now. Open a row to change it.' 2. A short band headed 'Needs setup' (small medium-weight heading) containing ONE ledger row: 'Integrations' with a puzzle-piece icon; sentence 'Cal.com isn't connected. PostHog, OpenRouter and Resend are configured.'; at right a small neutral outlined badge 'Not configured' and a chevron-right. 3. Group heading 'Application', then ledger rows separated by hairline dividers. Row anatomy: section name with small outline icon in a fixed 200px left column; a plain-language sentence of the current state in zinc-600 with the actual values in zinc-900 medium weight; at far right a small source badge and a chevron-right. Rows are about 64px tall, full width, list rows, not cards. 'Mail' — 'Admin mail sends as Birdcar from noreply@admin.birdcar.dev. Marketing mail sends as Birdcar from hello@birdcar.dev.' — badge 'Saved' (pale teal). 'Publishing' — 'Agent requests are running. 2 of 9 tasks are pinned to a model.' — badge 'Saved'. 'People & access' — '1 administrator: you. No pending invitations.' — badge 'Saved'. 'Customer sites' — 'New project sites use the Birdcar defaults.' — badge 'Default' (neutral gray). 'Notifications' — 'Attention alerts by email. Daily digest at 8:00 AM.' — badge 'Default'. 4. Group heading 'Your account', same row anatomy: 'Profile' — 'Nick Cannariato · nick.cannariato@birdcar.dev' — 'Saved'; 'Security' — 'Password set. Two-factor is on. 1 passkey.' — 'Saved'; 'Preferences' — 'Appearance follows your system. Times shown in America/Chicago.' — 'Default'.
